Every day several people also cross the 1 File No. 13013/5/BSP-PATHRAPALI/ADANI/FoB (Computer No.192125) Generated from eOffice by Manoj Sharma, Gm (Pd Piu Bilaspur) - Mks, Pd Piu-Bilaspur, Ro Raipur on 25/04/2025 6:53 Pm highway on foot for travel to local shops and village hut. The nearest Under Pass from this location is at Km 20+700 which is found cumbersome by the pedestrian traffic. This location falls in Sendri town which has a large population of about 5000 people. The highway passes through the middle of the village where the residents cross the Highway on foot through of the day. There is a large market of the village to which the villagers often travel by foot, there is also a mental hospital very close to this location. The nearest Under Pass from this location is at Km 24+854 which is quite far away for the pedestrian traffic for crossing National Highway. The location falls at Madanpur village on one side on Ranigaon village on the other. The estimated population of both these villages is 7500 people. Besides, every evening there is vegetable and foods mandi all along the highway. There is large number of daily needs shops in close vicinity of these locations. Large numbers of pedestrians commute for the above purpose and this location is an accident-prone zone. Further there is no Under Pass nearby this location for any possibility of channelizing the pedestrian traffic. d. Km 42+660 (Melnadih & Karra village):- The total population of Melnadih and Karra villages is about 4000 people. The villages are situated on both this side of the highwav. There is a Primary School at this location. The local traffic police has on several instances brought attention of the Authority for safety of children going to the school by crossing the National Highway on foot. There is also a bus stop very close to this location in which several passengers de-board for the nearby Khutaghat Dam. The nearest grade separated Under Pass is at Km 43+500 which is significantly away from this location. Therefore, there is a necessity to construct an FOB to cater to the above pedestrian traffic. e. Km 47+540 (Beltara Town):- The Beltara town is very large one of about 5000 resident At this location there is a Government High Secondary school as well as a primary heath hospital for the village. There is market /offices on both side of NH which includes Dhaba Daily Needs Shops, cloth market, Patwari office, Subji Mandi etc. Due to large pedestrian traffic at this location, it isessential to construct a FOB at In Re. Roads Of Chhattisgarh vs State Of Chhattisgarh And Others on 29 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182638837/ 3 this location . It is also submitted that there are crash barriers between Main Carriageway and Service Roads on the above locations which the pedestrians are found climbing the PGR for crossing the highway. Copy of the letter dated 26.04.2025 regarding grant of sanction for construction of five (05) Foot Over bridges is filed herewith as ANNEXURE R- 04/2. From perusal of the above affidavit it is apparent that a proposal was reviewed and forwarded with necessary comments to the proper authorities and finally on 08/04/2025, the Competent Authority had accorded approval for initiating the bidding process of 5 FoBs with a total cost of Rs.17,95,61,305/- and the copy of the letter dated 26/04/2024 regarding grant of sanction.
